verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph documents createUploadSession, which uploads byte ranges of a file in sequential requests and explicitly lets the transfer resume if the connection drops. The docs also note that the single-call PUT is capped at 250 MB, which makes upload sessions the documented route for big files. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of resume reliability in practice, and evidence on session details such as chunk-size rules or session expiry.
